1: // Game: Asteroid Dodge
2: // Canvas size: 800x600 (as per IDEA.md)
3: // Player: small ship (rectangle) controlled by Arrow keys/A/D and boost with Space.

5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) {
8:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
9:     return;
10:   }
11:   canvas.width = 800;
12:   canvas.height = 600;
13:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
14:   // Audio setup
15:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
16:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.type = 'sine';
20:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
21:     osc.connect(gain);
22:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
24:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
25:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration/1000);
26:     osc.start();
27:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration/1000);
28:   }
29:   function playBoost() { playTone(800, 100); }
30:   function playCollision() { playTone(200, 300); }
31:   function playGameOver() { playTone(100, 500); }
32: 
33:   // Player definition with boost flag
34:   const stars = [];
35:   // Generate starfield
36:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
37:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * 800, y: Math.random() * 600, radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
38:   }
39: 
40:   const player = {
41:     width: 40,

44:     y: canvas.height - 40,
45:     speed: 4,
46:     boostSpeed: 8,
47:     dx: 0,
48:     color: '#0f0',
49:     boosting: false,

51:   const player = {
52:     width: 40,
53:     height: 20,
54:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
55:     y: canvas.height - 40,
56:     speed: 4,
57:     boostSpeed: 8,
58:     dx: 0,
59:     color: '#0f0',
60:   };
61: 
62:   // Input handling
63:   const keys = {};
64:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
65:     keys[e.key] = true;
66:     if (e.key === ' ') playBoost();
67:   });
68:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
69:     keys[e.key] = false;
70:   });
71: 
72:   // Asteroid pool
73:   const asteroids = [];
74:   let asteroidSpawnTimer = 0;
75:   const baseSpawnInterval = 90; // frames
76:   let spawnInterval = baseSpawnInterval;
77:   let asteroidSpeed = 2;
78: 
79:   let score = 0;
80:   let startTime = performance.now();
81:   let gameOver = false;
82:   let gameOverPlayed = false;

84:   function spawnAsteroid() {
85:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20; // 20-50px
86:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
87:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed: asteroidSpeed });
88:   }
89: 
90:   function update() {
91:     if (gameOver) return;
92:     // Player movement
93:     player.dx = 0;
94:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) player.dx = -player.speed;
95:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) player.dx = player.speed;
96:     if (keys[' ']) {
97:     player.dx = (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ? -player.boostSpeed : (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ? player.boostSpeed : 0;
98:     player.boosting = true;
99:   } else {
100:     player.boosting = false;
101:   }
102:     player.x += player.dx;
103:     // Keep inside bounds
104:     if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
105:     if (player.x + player.width > canvas.width) player.x = canvas.width - player.width;
106: 
107:     // Spawn asteroids
108:     asteroidSpawnTimer++;
109:     if (asteroidSpawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
110:       spawnAsteroid();
111:       asteroidSpawnTimer = 0;
112:       // Gradually increase difficulty
113:       if (spawnInterval > 30) spawnInterval -= 0.5;
114:       asteroidSpeed += 0.01;
115:     }
116: 
117:     // Update asteroids
118:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
119:       const a = asteroids[i];
120:       a.y += a.speed;
121:       // Remove off-screen
122:       if (a.y - a.size > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
123:       // Collision detection (simple AABB)

142:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
143:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
144:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');

165:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
166:     ctx.stroke();
167:

170:       const radGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
171:         a.x + a.size / 2,
172:         a.y + a.size / 2,
173:         a.size * 0.1,
174:         a.x + a.size / 2,
175:         a.y + a.size / 2,
176:         a.size / 2
177:       );
178:       radGrad.addColorStop(0, '#555');
179:       radGrad.addColorStop(1, '#111');
180:       ctx.fillStyle = radGrad;
181:       ctx.beginPath();
182:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
183:       ctx.fill();
184:     }
185: 
186:     // Draw score
187:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
188:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
189:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
190: 
191:     if (gameOver) {
192:       // Play game over sound once
193:       if (!player.gameOverPlayed) {
194:         playGameOver();
195:         player.gameOverPlayed = true;
196:       }
197:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
198:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
199:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
200:       ctx.font = '48px monospace';
201:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
202:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
203:     }
204:   }
205: 
206:   function loop() {
207:     update();
208:     draw();
209:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
210:   }
211: 
212:   // Start the game

214: })();
